author: etherer
quote: Undoubtedly the best game on 3DS, the story even if a little basic remains interesting to do and we want to understand the final outcome that ultimately makes us emotional. The career system is super cool, and extends the life of the game as much as possible for those who like to complete a game to 100%. The DLC brings great longevity, the price of the DLC at the time was very cheap, they knew how to mix quality and quantity perfectly with an unbeatable price. This is a game that I recommend to all RPG fans

author: etherer
quote: It's a game that rocked my childhood, but also because of its great difficulty that makes you want to try again to succeed in defeating the bosses, the fact of alternating between Sora and Riku is an interesting mechanic, and the gameplay is fluid even if the camera goes in all directions, it's not the Kingdom Hearts where I liked the story the most and it's perhaps the only thing I can blame. Sora and Riku have never been so stylish, and despite some flaws it remains a beautiful game visually for the 3DS but also an important game for understanding the global history of KH.

author: etherer
quote: My favorite Kingdom Hearts! The story is so sad that nothing to think about it I have tears in my eyes, the system is a little repetitive and the game itself is not very beautiful (the DS system is not known for making very beautiful games), but apart from that I still play it from time to time, it is easy to handle and the characters are endearing

author: etherer
quote: A game that changed the formula known to all Kingdom Hearts, it is unloved, but I will say that it is more its modern version, the graphics are cute, the gameplay is easy to handle and the story is important to understand the other Kingdom Hearts

author: etherer
quote: After playing the remake, it was a beautiful game, so I decided to play the original game to see if it's always been as good as ever. Well it still deserves its place as the greatest game of all time, the graphics are dated of course, but the game is fluid, no notable bug except if you want to speedrun, but apart from that the music is just as great, the story is interesting, and the terrifying aspects are even more than terrifying in the remake, and it's great! I understand more and more why so many people say that this game changed their lives, because you can say that it changed mine. And now that I've played all versions: N64, 3DS and Switch 2, it deserves its place as the best game ever.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (1998)
